1.

Product Overview

Automated entry systems engineered for secure, convenient access across residential, commercial and industrial premises.

Motorised Gates are designed to provide secure, convenient and automated access for residential, commercial and industrial premises.

These gates can be operated through remote controls, access control systems, RFID, keypad, sensors or other automation systems, giving complete control over who enters a site and when.

Available in different designs and configurations to suit site requirements — from compact residential entries to heavy-duty industrial openings.

Automated Access

Remote, keypad, RFID or biometric-controlled entry.

Site Flexibility

Sliding, swing, folding and lift configurations available.

Heavy-Duty Build

Engineered for industrial and high-traffic openings.

Integration Ready

Works with boom barriers, CCTV and access systems.
